options_fancy_airstream_text: Beachside Airstream accommodation for couples and small groups seeking a unique island experience.
options_global_villa_features_airstream:
Important information about your booking.

ADW insurance: Non-refundable charge of 26.00 euros per person or £21.50 GBP (this replaces the refundable security deposit and covers clients for accidental damage on the Airstream) added to your final balance payment. Eco Tax: Government tourist's tax, payable in resort 2.20 euros per person per night. Check-in & Check-out: Check-in time is **4pm** on the day of arrival. Check-out time is **10am** on the day of departure. You will not be able to access the Airstream before 4pm without prior arrangement. 👉 Learn more about Early Check-in & Late Checkout options. Rubbish Collection: We offer a rubbish collection service for 125 euros. If you decide not to use this service, we will need to take this payment as a pre-authorised amount on a credit card as a rubbish deposit: This money is frozen in your account until it is released at the end of your stay. 🗑️ Book your rubbish collection service now. Food & Drinks: We can provide food and drinks to be waiting for you at the Airstream. 🛒 Pre-stock the Airstream with groceries and drinks. Airport Transfers: We can also organise your airport transfers. ✈️ Book your hassle-free airport transfer.
